scope: Reliability audit of existing source-specific method and setup identities. No new numerical training rule or transcript-integration completion claim.

existingSourceContexts.boundary: The fixed-geometry row method remains separate from a newly reviewed height/baseline.
Original unloaded stepping actuals retain their written height and pattern; new training still requires an available configured platform.
Recording previously written paired work does not bypass matched-pair or prerequisite admission for new workouts.
Original records retain their original method identity; they do not become evidence in a newly selected wave comparison.

appDecisions: Validate original canonical policy identities by bounded decoding and re-encoding through the existing policyFor implementation. Unknown, malformed, noncanonical, wrong-movement and incompatible prescription identities fail closed.
Retain original row/platform setup and paired-load actuals even after current apparatus or method changes. New planning retains all current inventory, skill, station and recovery restrictions.
Do not store a new programming context, rewrite old snapshots, migrate user data or change V33 namespaces. Existing policy keys already encode the supported identity.
Consume a pending load decision only when actual completed work matches both its weight and current method identity. Different-method work at the same numeric weight cannot consume it.
Check supported profile, timing, continuous work, total/per-side scope and optional weak-side metadata against the original method, rather than current settings.

regressions.before: An unchanged legacy press draft cannot validate after selecting wave programming: Draft does not match its programming.
regressions.after: Original actuals save/import/reload under their original policy; the new wave state remains at stage zero with zero streak.

regressions.before: After a genuinely earned new club-method load choice, saving an earlier legacy draft at the same numeric weight clears the pending choice.
regressions.after: The approved choice remains pending; old-method actuals remain in history without new-method credit.

verificationScope: 65 supported movement/profile combinations include custom club/wave nesting and row, paired, pushup and get-up revisions/options. Schema-only cases are never logged as physical work.
Actual save-path tests cover different-method work, legitimately earned pending loads, changed row geometry, unavailable platforms, removed pairs, unchanged snapshots and backup compatibility.

Touch browser tests at 320/390px import real JSON backups containing changed current settings and original active drafts, reload offline, save original actuals and verify independent current progression.

Existing double-hinge and step-up tests now separately assert historical snapshot compatibility versus current planning eligibility. Original malformed-data, actual-load, apparatus and source gates remain.
limits: No physical technique, real Android or complete source-method audit certification.
Original method identity determines historical comparison; current skills and equipment remain user configuration, not historical snapshots.
All ten Wildman release-gate areas remain unresolved.

Legacy drafts without a stored method key retain the prior current-policy fallback; no missing historical identity is invented. Weak-side comparison is restricted to the get-up key that actually captures it; unrelated legacy configuration fields are not retroactively inferred.
